what.value: A 30-second smoke test confirming the durable futon3c background-process facility is healthy in a freshly restarted JVM.
what.quote: **Purpose.** A 30-second smoke test to confirm the durable background-process facility is healthy in a freshly-restarted futon3c JVM, and that a launched process is parented to the JVM (so it will survive pouch teardown).
